up: Return the exact activity values for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614038. Include the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, and the activity details (standard_type, standard_relation, and standard_value).
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614038';
